## Outcome

Describe the user-visible or normative outcome.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests or fixtures cover the change.
- [ ] Specification and documentation agree.
- [ ] `make check` passes.
- [ ] Compatibility and security effects are described.
- [ ] Relevant conflicts of interest are disclosed.
- [ ] No secrets, private paths, transcripts, caches, or generated build outputs are included.

## RFC

Link the RFC for normative, schema, conformance, or governance changes; otherwise
state why none is needed.
